reason: Independent commercial-VCS hammering showed that update II=1 is restricted to consecutive predecoded groups within one active row. Four consecutive single-group K4 rows produced update intervals of 2,2,2 cycles because M127 cannot accept the next row while the retiring row or output stage is active.
paper_safe_statement: Commercial VCS admits exact M125-equivalent numeric behavior and an intra-row group II of one for M127. It does not admit an unqualified row-to-row II of one; consecutive single-group rows currently update every two cycles.
required_successor: A successor must accept and predecode the next row on the same cycle that the current last update retires, retain reset/fault quarantine, pass exact commercial-VCS equivalence, and obtain matched Synopsys timing evidence before any physical throughput claim.
precedence: This correction overrides only the throughput and pipeline-storage wording of the corrected contract. Frozen source hashes and the sealed functional VCS receipt remain unchanged.

Do not use M122 cycle projections without charging M127's current cross-row bubble.
